Use `snl entry package set` to move one Entry to a different Entry Package without hand-editing either membership index.

### Availability
This Entry is a normative product contract. The command is implemented only when its canonical path appears in machine-readable `snl --help`; absence means planned and unavailable, never silently emulated through a different command.


### Command path
`entry/package/set` is the canonical transport-neutral command. The intended shell spelling is `snl entry package set`. Current availability is advertised by machine-readable `snl --help`; an Agent/MCP adapter submits the same operation object instead of reconstructing shell text.

### Operation request
```json
{"protocol":"snl.operation/v1","command":"entry/package/set","root":"/absolute/workspace","arguments":{"id":"<exact-entry-id>","package":"<package-id>","expectedEntryRevision":"<opaque>","expectedSourcePackageRevision":"<opaque>","expectedDestinationPackageRevision":"<opaque>"}}
```
Every adapter accepts exactly this semantic request. Unknown argument keys are rejected. The CLI accepts `--root` and `--json` globally and emits one complete JSON document followed by a newline. Missing package, stale Entry/source-package/destination-package revision, or destination conflict leaves all authorities unchanged. Each expected revision names the authority it protects.

### Success result
A successful call exits `0` and returns `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":true,"command":"entry/package/set","data":{},"diagnostics":[]}`. `data` contains moved Entry readback and updated source/destination package revisions.

### Failure and exit semantics
Domain rejection (invalid data, not-found, conflict, or validation errors) exits `1`. Invocation, input I/O, unsupported workspace/schema, lock acquisition, and runtime failures exit `2`. Failure stdout under `--json` is exactly one `{"protocol":"snl.result/v1","ok":false,"command":"entry/package/set","error":{"code":"<stable-code>","message":"<actionable text>","details":{},"retryable":false}}`; no stack trace or prose contaminates stdout.

### State and concurrency
Mutating. Update entity ownership and every package membership authority in one lock-bound rollback-capable transaction. Revisions, cursors, checked digests, and workspace revisions are opaque tokens. After success, canonical readback and whole-workspace validation must observe the published state.
